title.zh: 宣布每年 7 月 28 日为北阿古桑省 Cabadbaran市特别非工作假日（名称为Cabadbaran日）的法案
title.en: An Act Declaring July 28 of Every Year A Special Nonworking Holiday in Cabadbaran City, Province of Agusan Del Norte, To Be Known As “Cabadbaran Day”, in Commemoration of Its Foundation Day
title.orig: An Act Declaring July 28 of Every Year A Special Nonworking Holiday in Cabadbaran City, Province of Agusan Del Norte, To Be Known As “Cabadbaran Day”, in Commemoration of Its Foundation Day
title.vi: Đạo luật tuyên bố ngày 28 tháng 7 hằng năm là ngày nghỉ lễ đặc biệt tại Thành phố Cabadbaran, Tỉnh Agusan Del Norte với tên gọi "Cabadbaran Day", nhân kỷ niệm Ngày Thành lập của địa phương
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติประกาศให้วันที่ 28 กรกฎาคมของทุกปีเป็นวันหยุดพิเศษในเมือง Cabadbaran จังหวัด Agusan Del Norte ในชื่อ "Cabadbaran Day" เนื่องในโอกาสวันสถาปนา
title.id: Undang-Undang menetapkan tanggal 28 Juli setiap tahun sebagai hari libur khusus di Kota Cabadbaran, Provinsi Agusan Del Norte dengan nama "Cabadbaran Day", dalam rangka memperingati Hari Jadi
title.ms: Akta mengisytiharkan 28 Julai setiap tahun sebagai hari cuti khas di Bandar Cabadbaran, Wilayah Agusan Del Norte dengan nama "Cabadbaran Day", sempena memperingati Hari Penubuhan

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2024/ra_12100_2024.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: July 28 of every year is hereby declared a special nonworking holiday in Cabadbaran City, Province of Agusan del Norte, to be known as "Cabadbaran Day", in commemoration of its foundation day.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
